name: Swinging acrobat
desc: A grimacing acrobat swings through the air while gripping a flexible pole with both hands.
desc_zh: 一名龇牙用力的杂技艺人双手紧握软杆，在空中摆荡飞跃。

name: Tavern bar fight
desc: A furious barmaid hoists a grinning halfling by the collar while a mustached guard rushes in amid a broken table and spilled mug.
desc_zh: 愤怒的酒馆女侍揪着嬉笑半身人的衣领将其拎起，一名蓄胡守卫冲上前来，周围是摔坏的桌子和泼洒的酒桶。

name: Boss door
desc: Arched double doors carved with flaming skull reliefs are held shut by a straining horned-helmet warrior and a seated bearded dwarf.
desc_zh: 一扇雕刻着燃烧骷髅浮雕的拱形双开门前，一名戴角盔的战士用力抵门，旁边坐着一名络腮胡矮人。

name: Sun cleric
desc: A solemn cleric in a pointed helm and scale armor wears a sun medallion and hefts a spiked mace.
desc_zh: 一名神情严肃的牧师头戴尖顶盔、身披鳞甲，胸前挂着太阳圣徽，手握带刺钉锤。

name: Duke Lion
desc: A blond noble swordsman leaps into battle brandishing a wavy-bladed sword overhead and carrying a round shield.
desc_zh: 一名金发贵族剑士跃入战斗，头顶挥舞波形刃长剑，另一手持圆盾。

name: Female dwarf warrior
desc: A grinning female dwarf in a horned helmet stands planted behind a great double-bladed axe resting on the ground.
desc_zh: 一名戴牛角盔的女矮人战士咧嘴而笑，双手扶着一柄立在地面的巨型双刃战斧。

name: Danny the cool dwarf
desc: A tattooed dwarf in a baseball cap and striped sunglasses holds a rune-etched axe with a chain dangling from his hand.
desc_zh: 一名戴棒球帽和条纹墨镜、满手纹身的矮人握着一柄刻有符文的巨斧，手边垂着一条铁链。

name: Dwarf with shield
desc: A scowling elderly dwarf charges forward with an axe raised high behind a painted oval shield.
desc_zh: 一名怒目圆睁的年长矮人高举战斧、身前挡着绘纹圆盾，向前冲锋。

name: Elf warrior in leaf armor
desc: A full-body elf in leaf-motif scale armor holds a curved blade at their side while raising one hand to their brow in a dramatic swoon.
desc_zh: 全身像：身着叶纹鳞甲的精灵一侧手握弯刀，一手扶额作戏剧化晕眩状。

name: Striking elf dual-swordsman
desc: An elf lunges low in a striking pose while gripping two curved swords against a dark scribbled backdrop.
desc_zh: 一名精灵压低身形突进，双手各握一柄弯刀挥砍，背景为黑色涂鸦笔触。

name: Fabio the fighter
desc: A grizzled muscular fighter in a tied headwrap and shoulder pauldron points ahead while drawing his decorated sword.
desc_zh: 一名戴扎结头巾、披肩甲的魁梧战士一手指向前方，一手抽出饰纹长剑。

name: Fighter with sword and shield
desc: A mustachioed fighter in a wide-brimmed kettle helm and scale armor stands ready with sword and round shield, a bedroll strapped to his back, against a dark scribbled background.
desc_zh: 一名留八字胡的战斗者头戴宽檐盔、身披鳞甲，手持长剑与圆盾、背负行囊戒备而立，背景为黑色涂鸦。

name: Goat-horned beholder
desc: A beholder-like aberration with curved goat horns, a keyhole-shaped pupil, and dripping eyestalks leers with a jagged toothy grin.
desc_zh: 一只眼魔状异怪生有弯曲山羊角与钥匙孔形瞳孔，滴液的眼柄环伺，咧嘴露出参差尖牙。

name: Hobbit holding a ring
desc: A grinning hobbit strides forward while pinching a sparkling gem ring aloft between two fingers.
desc_zh: 一名咧嘴而笑的霍比特人大步向前，两指高举一枚闪光的宝石戒指。

name: Hobbit hiker with backpack
desc: A smiling hobbit with an oversized backpack and a curled walking staff perches on a hilltop beneath a radiant sun and rolling hills.
desc_zh: 一名微笑的霍比特人背着超大行囊、手握卷头行路杖，坐在阳光与起伏山丘间的山顶上。

name: Hobbit clinging to cheese wheel
desc: A wide-eyed panicked hobbit clutches a holey cheese wedge while balanced atop a rolling wheel of cheese.
desc_zh: 一名双眼圆睁、惊慌失措的霍比特人紧抱一块带孔奶酪，骑坐在滚动的奶酪轮上。

name: Kobolds prying a bear trap
desc: Three kobolds crouch around a chained bear trap, prying its jaws while one counts coins from a small pouch.
desc_zh: 三个狗头人围着一个带铁链的捕兽夹，撬动夹齿的同时其中一个正数着钱袋里的金币。

name: Greedy Merchant with Coin Purse
desc: A grinning elderly merchant in a diamond-patterned robe holds out a tied pouch of coins.
desc_zh: 一名身穿菱纹长袍的年长商人咧嘴笑着,递出一袋系好的金币。

name: Adventurer Party on Night Watch
desc: A party of adventurers keeps watch around a campfire at night while glowing eyes peer from the darkness.
desc_zh: 夜晚,一队冒险者围坐在篝火旁守夜,黑暗中有一双发光的眼睛在窥视。

name: Ogre Swinging a Spiked Club
desc: A snarling ogre in ragged furs raises a spiked morning star overhead as it lunges to attack.
desc_zh: 一头披着破兽皮的食人魔咆哮着高举带刺钉头棒,扑身发起攻击。

name: Orc Guards Watching a Pie
desc: Two armored orc guards stand watch over a steaming pie atop a cracked stone pedestal littered with skulls and bones.
desc_zh: 两名披甲兽人卫兵看守着开裂石柱上热气腾腾的馅饼,柱脚散落着骷髅与骸骨。

name: Ring Lich
desc: A robed lich staggers from a hero's kick as a glowing magic ring is snatched from its skeletal hand.
desc_zh: 袍服巫妖被勇士一脚踢得踉跄,一枚发光的魔戒正从其骨手中被夺走。

name: King Tracing a Ritual Pentagram
name_zh: 描绘仪式五芒星的国王
desc: A crowned king lies prone on the ground, nervously tracing a pentagram ritual circle with one finger.
desc_zh: 一位头戴王冠的国王趴伏在地,紧张地用手指描绘着五芒星仪式法阵。

name: Rogue Cracking a Safe Dial
name_zh: 转动保险柜转盘的盗贼
desc: A grimacing rogue turns the dial of a steel safe door with a dagger tucked at his belt.
desc_zh: 一名龇牙咧嘴的盗贼腰别匕首,正转动钢制保险柜门上的转盘。

name: Skeleton warriors
desc: Five armored skeleton warriors crowd together brandishing spears, swords and a shield against a dark scribbled background, one with an arrow lodged in its skull.
desc_zh: 五名披甲骷髅战士挤站在一起，手持长矛、长剑与盾牌，其中一个头骨上插着箭，背景为黑色涂鸦。

name: Sorcerer with skull staff
desc: A fanged, fork-tongued sorcerer in a tall eye-emblazoned hat and flowing robes raises a clawed hand while carrying a staff topped with a skull and potion pouches at his belt.
desc_zh: 一名獠牙外露、吐着分叉长舌的术士头戴饰有眼睛纹章的高帽、身披长袍，一手举起利爪，身背骷髅头法杖，腰间挂着药袋与药瓶。

name: Thief Climbing a Brick Wall
desc: A hooded thief with a long pointed nose climbs a brick wall while carrying a tied loot sack on his back.
desc_zh: 一名戴兜帽的长鼻窃贼背着系好的赃物袋,正攀爬砖墙。

name: Adventurers fighting a troll
desc: A black-and-white doodle of four adventurers - an elf archer, a hooded mace-wielder, an axe-swinging dwarf and a spear-carrying porter - battling a club-wielding troll with an arrow in its eye.
desc_zh: 黑白涂鸦插画：精灵弓手、持锤兜帽人、挥斧矮人与背行囊的长矛手四人围攻一名眼中插箭、挥舞木棒的巨魔。

name: Vampire thrall
desc: A hooded vampire thrall in a rope-belted robe bares his fangs and raises both clawed hands against a dark scribbled background.
desc_zh: 一名身披兜帽、系绳带长袍的吸血鬼仆从露出尖牙，双手作爪状举起，背景为黑色涂鸦。

name: Adventurers peering down a well
desc: A point-of-view doodle from inside a well showing four adventurers - an elf in a feathered cap, a worried hooded human, a dwarf and a robed figure - peering over the stone rim while a rope dangles into the dark.
desc_zh: 从井底仰视的黑白涂鸦：戴羽帽的精灵、神情担忧的兜帽人类、矮人与袍服者四人趴在石井口向下张望，一根绳索垂入井中。

name: Wizard strangled by a snake
desc: A pointy-eared wizard in a pom-pom hat and robe grimaces in pain as a large snake coils around his neck and strangles him, his ornate staff flying from his grip.
desc_zh: 一名尖耳法师头戴绒球帽、身穿长袍，被一条缠住脖颈的巨蛇勒得面目狰狞，雕花法杖脱手飞出。

name: Elf knight with kite shield
desc: A full-body line-art doodle of an elf knight in plate armor holding a kite shield with a sword sheathed at his hip.
desc_zh: 全身线稿涂鸦：身穿板甲、手持鸢形盾、腰佩长剑的精灵骑士。

name: Horned-helm barbarian warrior
desc: A full-body doodle of a burly warrior in a winged horned helmet and fur mantle gripping a sword at his side.
desc_zh: 全身涂鸦：头戴带翼角盔、披毛皮斗篷、手握长剑的魁梧战士。

name: Star-robed wizard with orb staff
name_zh: 持法球法杖的星袍法师
desc: A full-body doodle of a bearded wizard in a star-and-moon patterned robe and tall pointed hat holding a staff topped with an orb.
desc_zh: 全身涂鸦：身穿星月纹长袍、头戴尖帽、手持顶端带法球法杖的长须法师。

name: Skeleton spear guard
desc: A full-body doodle of a skeleton guard in a broad-brimmed hat and patched tabard holding a spear and a round shield.
desc_zh: 全身涂鸦：戴宽檐帽、穿补丁罩衫、手持长枪与圆盾的骷髅卫兵。

name: Skeleton swordsman mid-swing
desc: A full-body doodle of an angry skeleton in patchwork armor raising a notched sword overhead to strike.
desc_zh: 全身涂鸦：身穿拼布甲、高举缺口长剑作劈砍状的愤怒骷髅。

name: Skeleton archer with bow
desc: A full-body doodle of a skeleton archer in a broad-brimmed hat and patched coat holding a bow with a nocked arrow and a quiver on his back.
desc_zh: 全身涂鸦：戴宽檐帽、穿补丁外套、手持上箭长弓并背箭袋的骷髅弓箭手。

name: Elf rogue with raised dagger
desc: A full-body doodle of a wide-eyed elf in a feathered cap raising a dagger while reaching out with his other hand.
desc_zh: 全身涂鸦：戴羽饰帽、睁大双眼、一手举匕首一手前伸的精灵。

name: Lightning toad monster
desc: A full-body doodle of a warty toad-like monster crouched between two jagged lightning bolts.
desc_zh: 全身涂鸦：蹲伏在两道锯齿闪电之间的疣皮蟾蜍怪。

name: Elf monarch with leaf crown
desc: A pointed-eared elf monarch crowned with leaves and branches stands in flowing robes holding a greatsword point-down and a small flask.
desc_zh: 一位尖耳精灵君主头戴枝叶王冠，身披长袍，手扶剑尖朝地的巨剑，另一只手提着小瓶。

name: Cheering dwarf artisan
desc: A braided dwarf woman cheers with a raised thumbs-up while holding a spiked cog wheel at her waist.
desc_zh: 一位梳着长辫的矮人女性竖起大拇指欢呼，腰间握着一个带尖齿的轮盘。

name: Thief carrying a loot sack
desc: A hooded thief hunches forward under an enormous loot sack with a sword hanging at their hip.
desc_zh: 一名戴兜帽的盗贼背着巨大的赃物袋弓身前行，腰侧佩着一把剑。

name: Scowling ogre brute
name_zh: 怒目而立的食人魔打手
desc: A hulking, scar-marked ogre brute in torn breeches stands scowling with clenched fists.
desc_zh: 一个满身伤疤、穿破烂短裤的魁梧食人魔握紧双拳，怒目而立。

name: Preaching cleric
desc: A robed cleric with closed eyes raises one arm in proclamation while holding an inscribed holy text in the other hand.
desc_zh: 一位身披长袍的牧师闭目举手宣示，另一只手捧着刻写的圣典。

name: Cheering elf crusader knight
name_zh: 欢呼的精灵十字军骑士
desc: A smiling elf knight in a helm and cross-emblazoned tabard raises both fists overhead in triumph.
desc_zh: 一名头戴头盔、身穿十字纹章战袍的精灵骑士面带微笑，高举双拳庆祝。

name: Seated tinker artisan
name_zh: 坐凳上忙活的修理工匠
desc: A messy-haired artisan with a round lens hunches over his gadgets while seated on a low stool.
desc_zh: 一位头发凌乱、戴圆镜片的工匠坐在矮凳上，弓身摆弄手里的物件。

name: Dancing jester with bells
desc: A grinning performer in a floppy hat and zigzag-hemmed tunic strides mid-dance while holding round bells in each hand.
desc_zh: 一名戴软帽、穿锯齿下摆短袍的表演者双手各持圆铃，咧嘴笑着迈步起舞。

name: Town guard with spear
desc: A mustachioed town guard in a studded kettle helm stands holding a spear with a sword sheathed at his belt.
desc_zh: 一名留胡子的城镇卫兵头戴铆钉铁盔，手握长矛、腰佩利剑站立。

name: Werewolf brute
desc: A muscular werewolf-like monster with stitched scars and a star tattoo on its shoulder snarls with bared fangs.
desc_zh: 一个肌肉发达的狼形怪物肩头带着缝合伤疤与星形纹身，龇牙咆哮。

name: Dwarf peddler with pots
desc: A stout dwarf in a beret and round spectacles carries round pots and a long-handled ladle while raising a greeting hand.
desc_zh: 一个戴贝雷帽和圆眼镜的矮胖矮人带着圆锅与长柄勺，抬手致意。

name: Young crossbow hunter
desc: A ponytailed child in a dotted tunic strides forward with a loaded crossbow and a quiver on her back.
desc_zh: 一个扎马尾、穿圆点上衣的孩子背着箭袋，端着上弦的弩迈步前进。

name: Hooded swordsman at vigil
desc: A stern hooded figure rests a hand on the pommel of a greatsword planted point-down before him.
desc_zh: 一个神情严肃的兜帽人物扶着倒立巨剑的剑柄伫立。

name: Wild boar
desc: A shaggy wild boar with curved tusks and small eyes stands in profile on stout legs.
desc_zh: 一头毛发蓬乱、獠牙弯曲的野猪用粗壮的腿侧身站立。

name: Goblin warrior
desc: A snarling goblin in spiked shoulder plates and patched breeches flexes its clawed hands.
desc_zh: 一个咧嘴咆哮的地精披着尖刺肩甲、穿着打补丁的裤子，张开爪手。

name: Guard with halberd
desc: A long-haired guard in a crested helmet holds a halberd upright over a mail-skirted tabard.
desc_zh: 一名长发卫兵头戴带饰头盔，身着锁甲裙摆，双手握戟而立。

name: winged bearded man
desc: A doodle of an angry winged man with pointed ears, a fanged open mouth and a long jagged beard, shown from the chest up in a draped robe.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格、神情愤怒的有翼男子，尖耳、张口露獠牙、留锯齿状长须，身披长袍的胸像。

name: one-eyed lobed aberration
desc: A doodle of a lumpy, lobed creature with a single central eye and a round mouth, standing on two stubby legs.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格、团块多叶的怪物，中央生着一只独眼和一张圆口，靠两条粗短的腿站立。

name: bird folk artisan in overalls
name_zh: 穿工装围裙的鸟人匠人
desc: A doodle of a bird-like folk character with a diamond beak and raised arms holding tools, wearing a pocketed apron overall.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的鸟形角色，菱形喙、双臂举起拿着工具，身穿带口袋的围裙工装。

name: goblin swordsman
desc: A doodle of a goblin with large pointed ears standing with clenched fists and a sword held point-down at its side.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的大耳地精双拳紧握站立，身侧握着一把剑尖朝下的剑。

name: bird folk wizard with staff
desc: A doodle of a bird-like wizard in a patched pointed hat and stitched robe, holding a tall staff with a blade-shaped tip.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的鸟形法师，戴补丁尖帽、穿缝线长袍，手持顶端呈刃形的长杖。

name: coin-tossing goblin
desc: A doodle of a goblin striding joyfully while tossing an arc of coins into the air.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的地精欢快迈步，向空中抛出一串硬币。

name: messenger bird with scroll
desc: A doodle of a hook-beaked bird carrying a large rolled scroll strapped across its back.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的钩喙鸟，背上绑缚着一卷带标签的大卷轴。

name: stooping bird with quill feather
desc: A doodle of a bird stooping with open beak and raised wing while a large quill feather rises behind its head.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的鸟俯身张口、扬起翅膀，头后竖着一根大羽毛笔。

name: pumpkin-headed mummy
desc: A doodle of a bandage-wrapped mummy-like figure with a grinning jack-o'-lantern pumpkin for a head.
desc_zh: 一幅涂鸦：缠满绷带的木乃伊式身影，顶着一颗咧嘴狞笑的南瓜灯脑袋。

name: guard girl with halberd and torch
name_zh: 持戟举火把的少女守卫
desc: A doodle of a young woman with hair buns and round glasses holding a halberd in one hand and a lit torch in the other.
desc_zh: 一幅涂鸦：梳双髻、戴圆眼镜的少女一手握长戟、一手举燃烧的火把。

name: knight with sword and shield
desc: A doodle of a mustached knight in a crested helmet raising a sword behind a kite shield on a black scribbled backdrop.
desc_zh: 一幅涂鸦：留胡子的骑士头戴冠盔，在黑色涂鸦背景前举剑持鸢形盾。

name: multi-eyed fanged aberration
desc: A doodle of a winged, many-eyed creature with huge fangs, a striped trunk and spindly legs.
desc_zh: 一幅涂鸦：长翅的多眼怪物，生有巨大獠牙、条纹长鼻和细长的腿。

name: wheel-faced cloaked creature
desc: A doodle of a cloaked creature whose face is a great spoked wheel, with a striped wrapped body beneath a flowing mantle.
desc_zh: 一幅涂鸦：披风怪物的脸是一个巨大的辐条轮盘，条纹缠裹的身子藏在飘动的斗篷下。

name: hooded monk with banner staff
desc: A doodle of a grim hooded monk in a long robe holding a palm leaf beside a staff topped with an orb and leaf banner.
desc_zh: 一幅涂鸦：神情凝重的兜帽长袍修士手持棕榈叶，身旁立着顶有圆球与叶幡的长杖。

name: grinning brute with twin daggers
desc: A doodle of a broad, grinning fighter with long black hair over one eye holding a jagged dagger in each hand.
desc_zh: 一幅涂鸦：体格魁梧、狞笑的战士长黑发垂遮一眼，双手各握一柄锯齿匕首。

name: startled hooded wizard
desc: A doodle of a hooded, robed figure throwing both arms up in alarm, face hidden in shadow with surprise lines radiating around the head.
desc_zh: 一幅涂鸦：兜帽长袍的身影惊慌地高举双臂，面孔隐于阴影，头旁画着放射状的惊愕线条。

name: Bat-winged monster imp
desc: A doodle full-body imp-like monster with bat wings sprouting from its head, a round belly, and bandage-wrapped legs.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的全身小怪物，头上长着蝙蝠翅膀，圆滚滚的肚子，腿上缠着绷带。

name: Elderly wizard with pointed hat
desc: A doodle bust of an elderly wizard wearing a tall bent pointed hat and round spectacles over a bushy beard.
desc_zh: 涂鸦半身像：戴高弯尖帽、圆眼镜、留浓密胡须的老年法师。

name: Elf necromancer holding a skull
name_zh: 持骷髅的精灵死灵法师
desc: A doodle full-body elf in a robe and cap holding a skull in one hand while lightning crackles from the other.
desc_zh: 涂鸦全身像：穿长袍、戴软帽的精灵法师一手托着骷髅，另一手放出闪电。

name: Skeleton raising its fists
desc: A doodle skeleton raising both clenched fists inside a wavy ghostly aura.
desc_zh: 涂鸦骷髅在波浪状幽光轮廓中举起双拳。

name: Goblin with an arrow in its head
desc: A doodle full-body goblin grinning with fangs while an arrow sticks out of its head and a spear rests at its side.
desc_zh: 涂鸦全身像：龇牙咧嘴的地精头上插着一支箭，身旁斜放着一杆长矛。

name: Bald barbarian brawler
desc: A doodle full-body muscular bald brawler clenching his fists and gritting his teeth.
desc_zh: 涂鸦全身像：肌肉发达的光头拳手双拳紧握、咬牙切齿。

name: Samurai warrior with katana
desc: A doodle full-body samurai in armor and a crescent-crested helmet holding a katana across his body.
desc_zh: 涂鸦全身像：身穿铠甲、头戴月牙饰盔的武士横握武士刀。

name: Mushroom guard with spear
desc: A doodle full-body mushroom creature with a spotted cap holding a spear as spore wisps rise above it.
desc_zh: 涂鸦全身像：头顶斑点菌盖的蘑菇人手持长矛，头顶飘着孢子气息。

name: frogfolk merchant with pet cat
desc: A doodle-style frog-like humanoid with a round coin emblem on its belly holds a fruit and a hanging pouch while a small cat sits at its feet.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的蛙形人生物腹部印有圆形钱币纹章，一手拿果实、一手提钱袋，脚边卧着一只小猫。

name: curled breathing dragon
desc: A doodle-style dragon coiled into a round boulder-like ball with its horned head at the bottom puffing out a breath.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的龙将身体蜷成圆球状，长角的头颅垂在下方，口中喷出一股气息。

name: elderly wizard reading a book
desc: A doodle-style elderly figure in a wide-brimmed hat and long robe stands reading an open book held in both hands.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的老者头戴宽檐帽、身披长袍，双手捧着一本打开的书站立阅读。

name: dwarf warrior with warhammer
desc: A doodle-style bearded dwarf plants his feet and swings a large emblem-marked warhammer overhead.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的大胡子矮人双腿开立，高举带徽记的战锤作挥击之势。

name: warrior with sword and shield
desc: A doodle-style long-haired warrior in chainmail stands holding a sword point-down in one hand and a round shield on the other arm.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的长发战士身穿锁子甲，一手扶着剑尖朝下的长剑，另一臂挽着圆盾站立。

name: angry bald swordsman
desc: A doodle-style bald, scowling fighter lunges forward with an upright sword in one hand and the other arm raised beside a lightning zigzag.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的光头怒目战士一手竖握长剑、另一臂高举，身旁伴着一道闪电折线，正大步前冲。

name: fantasy NPC doodle sheet
desc: A sheet of dozens of black-and-white doodle-style fantasy NPCs and monsters arranged in rows on a plain white background.
desc_zh: 一张在白色背景上按行排列数十个黑白涂鸦风格奇幻NPC与怪物的合集图。

name: fantasy NPC doodle sheet (transparent)
name_zh: 奇幻NPC涂鸦合集图（透明底）
desc: A transparent-background sheet of dozens of black-and-white doodle-style fantasy NPCs and monsters arranged in rows.
desc_zh: 一张透明底、按行排列数十个黑白涂鸦风格奇幻NPC与怪物的合集图。

name: Smiling elderly villager with basket
desc: A black-and-white line doodle of a smiling elderly villager in a floppy hat holding a woven basket and raising one fist.
desc_zh: 一幅黑白线条涂鸦，描绘一位戴软帽、手提编织篮并举起一只拳头的微笑老年村民。

name: Villager woman with barrel
desc: A simple line-art doodle on a transparent background of an elderly villager woman in a headscarf leaning on a wooden barrel while clutching a round vessel, with a few leaves drifting past.
desc_zh: 透明背景的简笔涂鸦：一位戴头巾的老年村妇倚靠着木桶、手抱圆形器皿，身旁几片叶子飘落。

name: Villager with proclamation tray
desc: A doodle of a bearded villager with wild hair holding up a tray bearing a written proclamation.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格、头发蓬乱的胡子村民高举放着告示文书的托盘。

name: Hooded rogue with slingshot
desc: A doodle of a grinning hooded man raising a slingshot in one hand.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格、咧嘴大笑的兜帽男子举着一把弹弓。

name: Farmer holding a potato
desc: A doodle of a smiling farmer woman in an apron holding up a potato, with a potato motif drawn on her apron and vegetables in her pocket.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的微笑农妇系着画有土豆图案的围裙，手举一颗土豆，口袋里装着蔬菜。

name: Baker with bread basket
desc: A doodle of a calling baker in a head covering holding a basket of pretzels and bread beside a sack of baguettes.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的面包师戴着头巾张嘴吆喝，挽着装椒盐卷饼和面包的篮子，身旁是一袋法棍。

name: Farmer with sunflower
desc: A doodle of a smiling woman in a tall hat holding a large sunflower against her chest.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的微笑女子戴着高帽，手捧一朵大向日葵。

name: Farmer carrying a harvest sack
desc: A doodle of a smiling farmer bent forward mid-stride under a heavy tied sack of harvested crops.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的微笑农夫弯腰迈步，背着捆扎沉重的庄稼收获袋。

name: Farmer with donkey
desc: A doodle of a grumpy-looking farmer in a laced vest standing close beside his donkey.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格、神情严肃的农夫穿着系带背心，站在他的驴子身旁。

name: Wizard with glowing orb
desc: A doodle of a hooded, robed wizard holding up a radiant glowing orb while carrying a basket of herbs.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的兜帽长袍巫师手举发光法球，另一手挽着一篮草药。

name: mushroom forager
desc: A smiling hooded villager holds up mushrooms in both hands behind a crate full of mushrooms.
desc_zh: 一位戴兜帽的微笑村民双手举着蘑菇，身前的木箱里装满蘑菇。

name: clown with bread basket
desc: A face-painted clown in a ruffled collar and apron carries a woven basket of bread.
desc_zh: 画着脸谱、戴褶领和围裙的小丑提着一篮面包。

name: elder villager with staff
desc: An elderly mustached villager in a leafy hat leans on a wooden staff beside a tree stump.
desc_zh: 一位戴叶饰帽、留胡子的老者拄着木杖站在树桩旁。

name: peddler with sack
desc: A hunched peddler carries an enormous sack on his back with a small pouch at his side.
desc_zh: 一个佝偻的行商背着巨大的包袱，身侧挂着小钱袋。

name: bearded villager
desc: A wild-haired bearded villager stands with fists on his hips and a small pouch at his belt.
desc_zh: 一个头发蓬乱、留胡子的村民双手叉腰，腰间挂着小袋。

name: grumpy villager at post
desc: A scowling villager hunches over and leans his arm on a carved wooden post.
desc_zh: 一个皱眉的村民弓身倚靠在雕花木桩上。

name: milkmaid with cow
desc: A bespectacled milkmaid sits on a stool milking a horned cow into a bucket.
desc_zh: 戴眼镜的农妇坐在小板凳上，对着木桶给有角的奶牛挤奶。

name: sheep rider
desc: A laughing villager rides a fluffy sheep with one fist raised in cheer.
desc_zh: 一个大笑的村民骑在毛茸茸的绵羊背上，高举拳头欢呼。

name: Villager with harvest basket
desc: A doodle-style villager with a dark bob haircut carries a large woven basket piled with leafy greens on her back and holds a braided rope in one hand.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的村民留着黑色波波头，背上背着装满绿叶菜的大编织篮，手里攥着一根编绳。

name: Farmer with sickle and straw hat
desc: A long-haired doodle farmer wearing a leaf-trimmed straw hat grips a sickle with a long curved blade, ready for the harvest.
desc_zh: 长发涂鸦农妇戴着饰叶草帽，手握一柄弯刃长镰，准备收割庄稼。

name: Shepherdess with crook and sheep
name_zh: 持牧杖的老牧妇与绵羊
desc: An elderly doodle shepherdess in a pointed hood holds a curved crook staff while a woolly sheep stands at her side.
desc_zh: 年迈的涂鸦牧妇戴着尖顶头巾、手持弯头牧杖，身旁站着一只卷毛绵羊。

name: Child riding a pig
desc: A shaggy-haired doodle child straddles a spotted pig and raises a thin switch while shouting aloud.
desc_zh: 头发蓬乱的涂鸦孩童骑在一头花斑猪背上，高举细枝大声吆喝。

name: Goose herder holding a goose
desc: A doodle villager with a big swirl of hair clutches a goose under one arm while two more geese waddle at her feet.
desc_zh: 顶着蓬发旋的涂鸦村民腋下夹着一只鹅，脚边还有两只鹅摇摇摆摆。

name: Farmer with straw hat and staff
desc: A smiling doodle farmer in a crosshatched straw hat leans on a long wooden staff held diagonally across his body.
desc_zh: 微笑的涂鸦农夫戴着网格纹草帽，斜拄一根长木杖站立。

name: Hooded chicken thief
desc: A sly doodle rogue in a pointed hood clutches a chicken under his arm with a mischievous grin.
desc_zh: 神情狡黠的涂鸦窃贼戴着尖兜帽，腋下紧紧夹着一只鸡，咧嘴坏笑。

name: Artisan carrying lumber planks
desc: A doodle artisan with coiled side buns carries a tall stack of wooden planks in her arms.
desc_zh: 扎着双侧发髻的涂鸦工匠怀里抱着一摞木板。

name: Elder villager with rose and cane
desc: An elderly doodle villager in a long cloaked robe holds a knobbed walking stick with a rose perched atop their head.
desc_zh: 年迈的涂鸦村民身披长袍,手握圆头拐杖,头顶一朵玫瑰。

name: Farmer with pitchfork
desc: A doodle farmer in a laced vest and boots stands gripping an upright three-pronged pitchfork.
desc_zh: 涂鸦农夫身穿系带背心与长靴,手握竖立的三齿干草叉。

name: Villager carrying sack overhead
desc: A mustachioed doodle villager hoists a large stitched sack over his head with both raised hands.
desc_zh: 留胡子的涂鸦村民双手将一个缝口麻袋举过头顶。

name: Villager behind wooden fence
desc: A bearded doodle villager leans over a rough plank fence, reaching out with one round hand.
desc_zh: 留胡子的涂鸦村民俯身在粗糙木板栏后,伸出一只圆圆的手。

name: Villager playing with dog
desc: A doodle villager raises a bone overhead while a spotted dog sits attentively at their side.
desc_zh: 涂鸦村民高举一根骨头,身旁坐着一只花斑狗。

name: Villager girl with shield
desc: A braided doodle villager girl in a star-patterned dress carries a large oval shield hung from a strap.
desc_zh: 梳辫子的涂鸦村姑身穿星星图案连衣裙,挎着一面系带的大椭圆盾。

name: Startled carpenter with saw
desc: A doodle carpenter in a soft cap holds a toothed saw and throws up a hand in surprise beside exclamation marks.
desc_zh: 戴软帽的涂鸦木匠手持齿锯,惊讶地举起一只手,旁有感叹号。

name: Butcher with list and bone
desc: A doodle butcher in a flat cap and apron holds a paper list while tucking a bone under his other arm.
desc_zh: 戴扁帽系围裙的涂鸦屠夫一手拿纸清单,另一只手臂夹着骨头。

name: Villager reading a notice
desc: A doodled male villager holds a large paper notice in both hands and shouts as if reading it aloud.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的男性村民双手举着一张大纸告示，张嘴仿佛在大声朗读。

name: waving villager woman
desc: A villager woman in a soft cap and apron dress raises one hand in a friendly wave.
desc_zh: 戴软帽、系围裙的村妇举起一只手友好地挥舞。

name: Baker slicing bread
desc: A doodled baker stands behind a work table with a fresh loaf of bread, one arm raised holding a bread knife.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的面包师站在放着面包的工作台后，一只手高举切面包刀。

name: Sausage seller
desc: A doodled male villager in a soft cap drapes a long string of sausages over his shoulders and holds a skewer stick.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的男村民戴软帽，肩上挂着一长串香肠，手里拿着一根签棍。

name: Bun seller with bowl
desc: A doodled male villager in a floppy cap calls out while holding a bowl piled with cross-marked buns.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的男村民戴软帽，张嘴吆喝，双手端着一盆带十字纹的圆面包。

name: old merchant with sack
desc: An old bearded merchant in a leafed cap and apron holds up a tied sack of goods.
desc_zh: 戴插叶便帽、系围裙的络腮胡老商人提起一个扎口的货袋。

name: Cookie seller with tray
desc: A doodled woman with dark shoulder-length hair holds a tray of six round cookies in front of her apron.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的黑发妇女系围裙，身前端着放有六块圆曲奇的托盘。

name: Cook in kitchen steam
desc: A doodled cook with a big black mustache and neckerchief stands with raised fists amid clouds of steam.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的厨师留黑色大胡子、系领巾，在蒸汽团中举起双拳站立。

name: Despairing farmer with grain sack
desc: A doodled farmer clutches his head in anguish as grain scatters into the air, his other hand gripping the tied neck of a sack marked with a wheat sprig.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的农夫痛苦地扶着头，麦粒在空中飞散，另一只手紧紧抓着画有麦穗图案的粮袋。

name: Baker carrying bread bundle on head
name_zh: 头顶面包包裹的面包师
desc: A bearded doodled villager balances a stitched sack topped with scored bread loaves on his head, standing stiffly in a short tunic.
desc_zh: 留胡子的涂鸦村民头顶一只缝补过的麻袋，袋上还摞着刻痕面包，身穿短衫僵直站立。

name: Baker woman balancing bread loaves
name_zh: 头顶面包的面包师女子
desc: A smiling baker woman with a long braid steadies a stack of scored bread loaves balanced on her head with both raised hands.
desc_zh: 微笑的面包师女子梳着长辫，双手举起扶稳头顶叠放的一摞刻痕面包。

name: Baker with crossed arms and loaf
desc: A baker in a puffy chef hat and round glasses crosses his arms over a round loaf while aromatic steam curls up beside him.
desc_zh: 戴蓬松厨师帽和圆眼镜的面包师双臂交叉抱着一只圆面包，身旁飘着香气般的蒸汽卷。

name: Baker woman hugging a loaf
name_zh: 紧抱面包的面包师女子
desc: A curly-haired baker woman in a long dress hugs a round loaf tightly to her chest with crossed arms, gritting her teeth as steam swirls around her.
desc_zh: 卷发的面包师女子身穿长裙，交叉双臂把圆面包紧紧抱在胸前，咬着牙，周身蒸汽缭绕。

name: cook with spoon and baguette
name_zh: 持勺与长棍面包的厨师
desc: A curly-haired doodle cook in an apron and neckerchief raises a wooden spoon in one hand and a long baguette in the other.
desc_zh: 卷发的简笔画厨师系着围裙和领巾，一手高举木勺，一手举着长棍面包。

name: baker holding baguettes
desc: A doodle baker in a floppy pointed hat and checkered apron cradles slashed baguettes in one arm while raising a finger with the other hand.
desc_zh: 戴松软尖帽、系格纹围裙的简笔画面包师一臂抱着划口长棍面包，另一手竖起手指。

name: Villager carrying a giant cabbage
desc: A stout villager in a stitched cape and striped trousers balances an enormous swirled cabbage over their head with fists balled at their sides.
desc_zh: 矮胖的村民披着缝线斗篷、穿条纹裤，头顶一颗巨大的旋纹白菜，双拳紧握垂在身侧。

name: Villager with feathered hat and bindle stick
name_zh: 戴羽帽扛行囊棍的村民
desc: A doodled villager in a feathered cap strides forward carrying a pole with a small bundle slung over his shoulder.
desc_zh: 一个戴羽毛帽的涂鸦村民迈步前行，肩上扛着挑有小包袱的木棍。

name: Old villager with gnarled staff
desc: A grumpy elderly villager in a long robe and small cap leans on a gnarled wooden staff.
desc_zh: 一位神情严肃的老村民身穿长袍、头戴小帽，拄着一根扭曲的木杖。

name: Villager with lantern
desc: A villager in a fur-trimmed hood holds a round lantern while a small chicken perches on top of his head.
desc_zh: 一位戴毛边兜帽的村民手提圆灯，头顶还停着一只小鸡。

name: Villager holding a sunflower
desc: A smiling villager with wavy hair holds a large sunflower bloom in her hands.
desc_zh: 一位卷发微笑的村民双手捧着一朵硕大的向日葵。

name: Hooded cloaked villager
desc: A villager bundled in a pointed hood and a long wrapped cloak stands facing forward.
desc_zh: 一位裹着尖顶兜帽和长披风的村民正面而立。

name: Market villager with baskets
desc: A villager in a pleated skirt carries two woven baskets full of goods at either side.
desc_zh: 一位穿褶裙的村民身侧挑着两只装满货物的编织篮。

name: Stout villager in turban
desc: A stout bearded villager wearing a wrapped turban and a studded vest stands with a fist at his side.
desc_zh: 一位身材壮硕、留胡子的村民缠着头巾、穿着缀钉背心，握拳立于原地。

name: Villager holding up a trinket
desc: A long-haired bearded villager in a pointed hat holds up a small round object with one hand while resting the other on his hip.
desc_zh: 一位长发留胡、戴尖帽的村民一手叉腰，一手举起一个小圆物件。

name: old villager with pouch
desc: A bald elderly man with a scarred scalp and bushy brows stands clenching one fist while a dark pouch hangs at his side.
desc_zh: 一位秃顶、头皮带疤的老村民握紧拳头站立，身侧挂着一个深色钱袋。

name: praying veiled woman
desc: A woman in a floor-length robe and trailing hood clasps her hands together in prayer.
desc_zh: 一位身穿长袍、头披垂巾的女子双手合十祈祷。

name: wizard in pointed hat
desc: A mustached man in a tall pointed hat, bow tie, and round robe stands with his arms spread wide.
desc_zh: 一位留胡子、戴高尖帽、系领结的男子张开双臂站立。

name: villager woman pointing by stone wall
desc: A woman with hair in side buns points to one side while standing behind a low stone wall.
desc_zh: 一位梳着侧发髻的女子站在矮石墙后指向一旁。

name: stonemason with mallet
desc: An elderly bearded man in a flat cap raises a mallet while working among cut stones and boulders.
desc_zh: 一位戴扁帽、留大胡子的老石匠在石块间高举木槌劳作。

name: villager behind boulders
desc: A mustached man with a topknot leans behind a pile of cracked boulders with a curved blade rising at his side.
desc_zh: 一位扎发髻、留胡子的男子倚身于裂开的巨石堆后，身侧立着一弯刃形物。

name: tavern keeper with beer and roast chicken
name_zh: 端啤酒和烤鸡的酒馆老板娘
desc: A woman in an apron holds a foaming beer mug in one hand and a platter with a steaming roast bird in the other.
desc_zh: 一位系围裙的女子一手举着冒泡的啤酒杯，一手端着冒热气的烤鸡盘。

name: baker with bread basket
desc: A freckled, curly-haired baker grins while carrying a frilled basket filled with loaves of bread.
desc_zh: 一位卷发、带雀斑的面包师笑着抱着一篮带褶边的面包。

name: hooded villager with beer stein
desc: A hooded elderly villager clasps a large beer stein close to his chest.
desc_zh: 一位戴兜帽的年长村民双手捧着一大杯啤酒。

name: barmaid with tray of beer mugs
desc: A barmaid in a headscarf and apron holds up a tray with two foaming beer mugs.
desc_zh: 戴头巾、系围裙的女侍者高举放有两杯泡沫啤酒的托盘。

name: baker carrying basket of bread
desc: A mustached baker in a paper cap carries a basket of bread loaves against his chest.
desc_zh: 戴纸帽、留胡子的面包师胸前抱着一篮面包。

name: waitress with wine bottle and glass
name_zh: 端葡萄酒托盘的女侍者
desc: A long-haired waitress strides along while balancing a tray with a wine bottle and a filled glass.
desc_zh: 长发女侍者迈着大步,托着放有葡萄酒瓶和斟满酒杯的托盘。

name: pastry peddler with pies and price tags
desc: A hooded peddler spreads her arms among pies on sticks, a lattice waffle and hanging price tags.
desc_zh: 戴兜帽的女行商张开双臂,身旁有串着的馅饼、格纹华夫饼和价签。

name: traveling merchant with pack and coin purse
desc: A balding traveling merchant hauls a lattice-wrapped pack on his back while clutching a tied coin purse.
desc_zh: 秃顶的行商背着格纹货包,手里攥着系口的钱袋。

name: townsman in feathered hat
desc: A bearded townsman in a feathered hat and belted tunic stands with a hand on his hip.
desc_zh: 戴羽毛帽、留胡子的镇民身穿束腰外衣,单手叉腰站立。

name: elderly villager pointing at sign
desc: An elderly aproned villager points down at a blank placard on a post while holding a small round pan.
desc_zh: 系围裙的年长村民一手指向木桩上的空白告示牌,另一手拿着小圆锅。

name: Villager woman holding a notice
desc: A doodle-style village woman in a headscarf and long robe proudly holds up a sheet of paper.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的乡村妇女戴着头巾、身穿长袍，高高举着一张纸。

name: Old man reading a scroll
desc: An elderly bearded villager carefully unrolls and reads a long parchment scroll.
desc_zh: 一位年迈多须的村民小心地展开并阅读一卷长长的羊皮纸卷轴。

name: Village girl behind a wooden stall
desc: A smiling village child with curly pigtails stands behind a rough wooden stall with a lattice front.
desc_zh: 一个扎着卷曲双辫的微笑乡村孩子站在带格栅的粗糙木摊后面。

name: Bald villager in patched trousers
desc: A bald, bearded villager in a tunic and patched pants stands with his arms spread wide.
desc_zh: 一位光头留须的村民身穿束腰外衣和打补丁的裤子，张开双臂站立。

name: Mustached craftsman by a wooden board
desc: A mustached craftsman in a cap and apron stands with a fist on his hip beside a rough knotted wooden board.
desc_zh: 一位戴帽系围裙、留浓髭须的工匠手叉腰，站在一块带节疤的粗糙木板旁。

name: Grinning villager with a dangling pouch
name_zh: 拎着小袋咧嘴笑的村民
desc: A wild-haired villager in a belted robe grins toothily while dangling a small pouch from one hand.
desc_zh: 一个头发凌乱、身穿系带长袍的村民咧嘴露齿而笑，手里拎着一只小袋。

name: Townswoman with quill and ledger
name_zh: 持羽毛笔和账板的女市民
desc: A woman with a topknot bun and ruffled collar holds a feather quill beside a tall written ledger board.
desc_zh: 一位挽着发髻、戴褶边领的女子手持羽毛笔，身旁立着一块写满字的高账板。

name: Farmer holding a basket of herbs
desc: A long-haired, mustached villager in a fringed robe holds up a round basket topped with leafy sprigs.
desc_zh: 一位长发蓄须、穿流苏长袍的村民高举一个插着叶枝的圆篮。

name: old farmer with produce crate
desc: A black-line doodle of an elderly mustached farmer in a wide-brimmed hat carrying a wooden crate stenciled with a leaf.
desc_zh: 黑白简笔画：戴宽檐帽、留大胡子的老农抱着印有叶子图案的木箱。

name: villager with woven bag
desc: A black-line doodle of a villager with a wrapped headcloth carrying a crosshatched woven bag at the waist.
desc_zh: 黑白简笔画：头裹布巾的村民腰前挎着网格纹编织袋。

name: craftsman with mallet
desc: A black-line doodle of a balding, mustached craftsman in an apron holding a mallet beside a wooden work box.
desc_zh: 黑白简笔画：秃顶留胡子的匠人系着围裙，手握木槌站在木箱旁。

name: blacksmith with horseshoes
desc: A black-line doodle of a hooded blacksmith standing behind an anvil and raising a horseshoe in each hand.
desc_zh: 黑白简笔画：戴兜帽的铁匠站在铁砧后，双手各举一只马蹄铁。

name: smith girl swinging mallet
desc: A black-line doodle of a ponytailed craftswoman swinging a large mallet overhead amid radiating motion lines.
desc_zh: 黑白简笔画：扎马尾的女匠人高举大木槌作挥击状，周围有动感线条。

name: laborer with shoulder sack
desc: A black-line doodle of a neck-scarfed laborer carrying a sack on his shoulder while gripping a handled tool beside a crate.
desc_zh: 黑白简笔画：系领巾的劳工肩扛麻袋，手握带柄工具，身旁放着木箱。

name: surprised villager behind cow
desc: A black-line doodle of a horned cow with a wide-eyed, open-mouthed villager peeking out from behind its body.
desc_zh: 黑白简笔画：一头长角奶牛身后探出一位瞪眼张嘴的惊讶村民。

name: artist with raised brush
desc: A black-line doodle of a curly-haired artist raising a bristled brush while standing behind a stone pedestal.
desc_zh: 黑白简笔画：卷发的画匠站在石台后，高举一把毛刷。

name: Barrel-carrying cooper villager
desc: A doodle-style villager leans forward carrying a large barrel under one arm while raising a mallet in his other hand.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的村民俯身用一只手臂夹着大木桶，另一只手高举木槌。

name: Cheering hooded villager
desc: A doodle-style hooded villager shouts joyfully with one fist raised while clutching a round object in the other hand.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的兜帽村民兴奋地高举拳头呼喊，另一只手攥着一个圆形物件。

name: Villager packing a crate with mallet
desc: A doodle-style villager raises a mallet over a labeled wooden crate while steadying it with the other hand.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的村民一手高举木槌，一手扶着贴有标签的木箱。

name: Bearded elder villager with flower
desc: A doodle-style elderly bearded villager in a crown-like cap and apron holds a flower at his waist.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的老者村民头戴冠状帽、系着围裙，腰际手持一朵花。

name: Village woman holding a lit candle
desc: A doodle-style village woman in a headscarf and apron holds up a lit candle in a candlestick.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的村妇头戴头巾、系着围裙，手举一支点燃的蜡烛。

name: Candle seller beside a barrel
desc: A doodle-style villager with bobbed hair and an apron gestures beside a barrel topped with two candles.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的短发村民系着围裙，站在插着两支蜡烛的木桶旁抬手示意。

name: Candle seller with tray basket
desc: A doodle-style mustached villager carries a tray basket filled with upright candles.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格留胡子的村民端着装满竖立蜡烛的篮筐。

name: Singing villager with two lit candles
desc: A doodle-style long-haired villager sings with open mouth while holding a lit candle in each raised hand.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的长发村民张口歌唱，双手各举一支点燃的蜡烛。

name: Elder villager carrying a pie
desc: A doodle-style elderly villager walks while carrying a steaming fresh pie on a wooden tray.
desc_zh: 涂鸦风格的老年村民端着木托盘上冒着热气的新鲜派行走。

name: Villager doodle set 1
desc: A sheet of dozens of hand-drawn doodle villagers — farmers, shepherds, bakers and merchants — in black line art on a white background.
desc_zh: 白底黑线的手绘涂鸦村民角色合集图版，包含农夫、牧人、面包师与商贩等数十个角色。

name: Villager doodle set 1
desc: A transparent-background sheet of dozens of hand-drawn doodle villagers — farmers, shepherds, bakers and merchants — in black line art.
desc_zh: 透明背景的手绘涂鸦村民角色合集图版，包含农夫、牧人、面包师与商贩等数十个黑线角色。

name: Villager tradesfolk doodle set 2
desc: A sheet of doodle villager tradesfolk — blacksmiths, bakers, tavern keepers, miners, tailors and bards — in black line art on a white background.
desc_zh: 白底黑线的涂鸦村民百工角色合集图版，包含铁匠、面包师、酒馆招待、矿工、裁缝与吟游诗人等角色。

name: Villager tradesfolk doodle set 2
desc: A transparent-background sheet of doodle villager tradesfolk — blacksmiths, bakers, tavern keepers, miners, tailors and bards — in black line art.
desc_zh: 透明背景的涂鸦村民百工角色合集图版，包含铁匠、面包师、酒馆招待、矿工、裁缝与吟游诗人等黑线角色。

name: Hooded zealot raising arms
desc: A hooded, robed zealot with a skull-like face in shadow raises both arms amid emphatic starbursts.
desc_zh: 兜帽长袍的狂信者在阴影中露出骷髅般的面孔，双臂高举，周围画着强调用的星芒。

name: Weeping flagellant zealot
desc: A bald, gaunt zealot with pointed ears wails with streaming tears, bare-chested with clawed hands outstretched.
desc_zh: 秃顶消瘦、尖耳的狂信者赤裸上身、爪状双手张开，泪流满面地哀嚎。

name: Weeping zealot in prayer
desc: A bald, robed zealot weeps with hands clasped together in prayer at the chest.
desc_zh: 秃顶的长袍狂信者双手在胸前合十祈祷，泪水从眼中流下。

name: weeping zealot
desc: A robed zealot stands with arms spread wide, hollow eyes weeping black tears as its mouth opens in a fervent chant.
desc_zh: 一名身着长袍的狂信者张开双臂站立，空洞的双眼流下黑色泪水，张口狂热吟诵。

name: zealot with holy symbol
desc: A hooded zealot stands robed with a radiant holy emblem emblazoned on its chest, black tears streaking from hollow eyes.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者身披长袍，胸前饰有放射状圣徽，空洞的双眼流下黑色泪痕。

name: zealot ritual trio
desc: Three hooded zealots crowd together in a frenzied ritual, one screaming while hoisting a board overhead and another gripping a serrated saw.
desc_zh: 三名兜帽狂信者挤在一起进行狂乱的仪式，一人高举木板尖叫，另一人手握锯齿刀。

name: zealot with gem staff
desc: A hooded zealot clutches a gem-tipped staff diagonally across its robe, its shadowed face weeping black tears.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者将一根镶宝石的法杖斜抱在袍前，阴影中的面孔流下黑色泪痕。

name: kneeling zealot with raised arms
desc: A zealot kneels in its robe with both arms raised heavenward, its hooded face streaked with black tears.
desc_zh: 一名狂信者身披长袍跪地，双臂高举向天，兜帽下的面孔挂着黑色泪痕。

name: zealot with raised fist
desc: A snarling zealot with gritted teeth thrusts one fist overhead in rallying fury, black tears running from its eyes.
desc_zh: 一名咬牙切齿的狂信者高举一只拳头，神情激愤，眼中流下黑色泪水。

name: zealot with forked staff
desc: A robed zealot grips a tall forked staff while a holy emblem marks its chest, black tears streaming from hollow eyes.
desc_zh: 一名长袍狂信者手握高高的叉形法杖，胸前饰有圣徽，空洞的双眼流下黑色泪水。

name: zealot with shield and whip
desc: A hooded zealot raises a curling whip in one hand and bears an oval shield on the other arm, its masked face weeping black tears.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者一手高举卷曲的长鞭，另一臂挽着椭圆盾牌，面具般的面孔流下黑色泪水。

name: preaching hooded zealot
desc: A hooded zealot in a long robe gestures with clenched fists while a tattered stole hangs down the front.
desc_zh: 身穿长袍的兜帽狂信者握拳示意，胸前垂着破旧的圣带。

name: hooded zealot with staff
desc: A hooded zealot holds a tall leaf-tipped staff in one hand and clutches a dark relic in the other.
desc_zh: 兜帽狂信者一手握着叶尖长杖，一手紧握暗色圣物。

name: hooded zealot with skull mask
name_zh: 持骷髅面具的兜帽狂信者
desc: A hooded zealot gestures outward while a round skull-faced mask with crossed eyes hangs at the belly.
desc_zh: 兜帽狂信者向外示意，腹前挂着一张叉眼骷髅面具。

name: praying hooded zealot
desc: A hooded zealot clasps both fists before the chest in prayer, wearing a robe marked with rows of dots.
desc_zh: 兜帽狂信者双拳合于胸前祈祷，长袍上缀有成排圆点。

name: hooded zealot with cauldron
desc: A hooded zealot rests clenched fists on the rim of a great round cauldron while smoke wisps rise and flames lick its base above a string of beads.
desc_zh: 兜帽狂信者双拳扶在圆釜边缘，烟雾升起，釜底火焰舔舐，下方串珠环绕。

name: hooded zealot with interlocked fingers
name_zh: 十指交扣的兜帽狂信者
desc: A hooded zealot stands in a wide robe with fingers interlocked in prayer before the chest.
desc_zh: 兜帽狂信者身着宽袍，十指交扣于胸前祈祷。

name: hooded zealot with crystal staff
name_zh: 持水晶法杖的兜帽狂信者
desc: A grinning hooded zealot in a shoulder cape grips a staff topped with a cluster of crystals.
desc_zh: 咧嘴而笑的兜帽狂信者披着肩帽，手握顶端镶满水晶的法杖。

name: chanting zealot with raised brand
name_zh: 高举火把吟诵的狂信者
desc: A shouting hooded zealot raises both arms, one fist gripping a jagged flaming brand, with a buckled belt at the waist.
desc_zh: 兜帽狂信者高举双臂呐喊，一手握着锯齿状火把，腰间系着带扣腰带。

name: Zealot holding a skull
desc: A hooded zealot in a long robe cradles a human skull in both hands before their chest.
desc_zh: 一名头戴兜帽、身披长袍的狂信者双手在胸前捧着一具人类骷髅。

name: Zealot with shield
desc: A hooded zealot in robes strides forward carrying an oval shield on one arm.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽长袍的狂信者手臂上挽着一面椭圆盾牌前行。

name: Zealot flanked by skeletons
desc: A hooded zealot wearing an eye-shaped amulet stands between two grinning skeletons.
desc_zh: 一名佩戴眼形护符的兜帽狂信者站在两具咧嘴骷髅之间。

name: Zealot summoning tentacles
desc: A hooded zealot raises both fists while spotted tentacles writhe up around them.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者高举双拳，斑点触手在其周身翻卷升起。

name: Elder zealot with staff
desc: An elderly bearded zealot in robes holds a tall crooked staff and wears a sunburst emblem on his chest.
desc_zh: 一位年迈长须的狂信者身披长袍，手握高挑的弯头法杖，胸前佩着日轮徽记。

name: Ecstatic zealot
desc: A hooded zealot throws both fists skyward in ecstatic fervor above a jagged pile of debris.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者亢奋地将双拳举向天空，身下是嶙的碎石残堆。

name: Zealot with sword and skull
desc: A hooded zealot brandishes a sword and holds aloft a skull while perched above a giant spider.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者一手挥剑一手高举骷髅，立于一只巨蛛之上。

name: Cultists stabbing a victim
desc: Four hooded cultists seize and stab one of their own as black blood spurts from the wound.
desc_zh: 四名兜帽狂信者按住并刺杀其中一人，伤口喷溅出黑色的血液。

name: weeping bald zealot with lantern
name_zh: 提灯哭泣的光头狂信者
desc: A bald zealot weeps streams of tears while dressed in a collared cloak with a diagonal sash and carrying an oval lantern at his side.
desc_zh: 一名光头狂信者泪流满面，身披带斜绶带的翻领斗篷，身侧提着一盏椭圆灯笼。

name: hooded zealot kneeling before horned zealot
name_zh: 跪拜有角狂信者的兜帽狂信者
desc: A kneeling hooded zealot reaches out toward a standing horned, claw-handed celebrant in tattered robes perched on a round mat.
desc_zh: 一名跪地的兜帽狂信者伸手朝向站在圆垫上、身披破袍的有角利爪主祭。

name: zealots brewing at the cauldron
desc: Two pointed-hood zealots tend a great cauldron over flames while a bald figure rises from the brew and a wide-eyed companion watches from the side.
desc_zh: 两名尖帽狂信者在火焰上照看一口大锅，锅中探出一个光头身影，旁边一名睁大双眼的同伴在旁观。

name: hooded zealot with twin flames
name_zh: 手托双焰的兜帽狂信者
desc: A pointed-hood zealot in a long robe raises both fists, each crowned with a wavering flame.
desc_zh: 一名尖帽兜帽狂信者身着长袍，举起双拳，每只拳头上都托着一簇摇曳的火焰。

name: hooded zealot with lantern and flaming staff
name_zh: 持灯与火焰法杖的兜帽狂信者
desc: A hooded zealot wearing an eye medallion holds a ribbed lantern in one hand and a flaming staff in the other.
desc_zh: 一名佩戴眼睛徽记的兜帽狂信者一手提着罗纹灯笼，一手举着燃烧的法杖。

name: bearded hooded zealot with sash
name_zh: 系绶带的络腮胡兜帽狂信者
desc: A bearded hooded zealot with a diagonal sash clenches one fist and holds a wavering flame in the other hand.
desc_zh: 一名留络腮胡、系斜绶带的兜帽狂信者一手握拳，另一手托着摇曳的火焰。

name: grinning hooded zealot
name_zh: 咧嘴而笑的兜帽狂信者
desc: A hooded zealot grins toothily from the shadow of a pointed hood, standing with clenched fists and trailing sleeves.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者从尖帽的阴影中露齿而笑，双拳紧握、衣袖垂落而立。

name: praying hooded zealot
name_zh: 合十祈祷的兜帽狂信者
desc: A hooded zealot in a long robe stands with hands clasped together in prayer at the chest.
desc_zh: 一名身着长袍的兜帽狂信者双手在胸前合十祈祷而立。

name: Screaming hooded cultist with spirit face
name_zh: 嘶吼的兜帽狂信者与灵魂面孔
desc: A hooded cultist screams with both fists clenched while a tormented spirit face floats above their head.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者双拳紧握嘶吼,头顶悬浮着一张痛苦的灵魂面孔。

name: Hooded cultist raising a clawed hand
name_zh: 举起爪手的兜帽狂信者
desc: A hooded cultist with a gaunt grimacing face raises one clawed hand in a dark conjuring gesture.
desc_zh: 一名面容枯槁狞笑的兜帽狂信者举起一只爪手,做出黑暗的施法手势。

name: Cultist summoning a vision orb
name_zh: 召唤幻象水晶球的狂信者
desc: A hooded cultist raises both arms toward a floating orb containing a face, standing behind a woven web platform between two candles.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者双臂高举,朝向悬浮着面孔的水晶球,站在两支蜡烛间的编织网台前。

name: Chanting cultist in a woven nest
name_zh: 巢穴中举爪吟诵的狂信者
desc: A bald cultist chants with both clawed hands raised while a screaming vision face floats above their head, standing in a woven nest of twigs.
desc_zh: 一名光头狂信者高举双爪吟诵,头顶悬浮着一张嘶吼的幻象面孔,站在树枝编织的巢穴中。

name: Kneeling cultist beneath a crescent moon
desc: A hooded cultist kneels in prayer on the ground beneath a large crescent moon.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者在巨大新月下跪地祈祷。

name: Hooded cultist with arms crossed
name_zh: 抱臂而立的兜帽狂信者
desc: A hooded cultist with a pointed hood stands solemnly with arms folded across the chest over a diagonal strap.
desc_zh: 一名尖顶兜帽狂信者胸前斜挎束带,双臂交叠,肃然而立。

name: Hooded cultist holding a staff diagonally
name_zh: 斜握法杖的兜帽狂信者
desc: A hooded cultist grips a long staff diagonally across the chest with both hands.
desc_zh: 一名兜帽狂信者双手将一根长法杖斜握在胸前。

name: Weeping robed cultist with amulet
name_zh: 佩戴护符的流泪长袍狂信者
desc: A robed cultist with a weeping, open-mouthed face wears a round amulet on the chest and clenches both fists at the sides.
desc_zh: 一名长袍狂信者面带流泪嘶吼的表情,胸前佩戴圆形护符,身侧双拳紧握。

name: zealot cultist doodle sheet
desc: A sheet of dozens of black-ink doodle zealots and cultists in hooded robes wielding staves, blades, bows, skulls and cauldrons on a white background.
desc_zh: 一张黑白线条涂鸦图集，白色背景上绘有数十个身披兜帽长袍、手持法杖、刀剑、弓弩、骷髅与坩埚的狂信者。

name: zealot cultist doodle sheet
desc: A transparent-background sheet of dozens of black-ink doodle zealots and cultists in hooded robes wielding staves, blades, bows, skulls and cauldrons.
desc_zh: 一张透明背景的黑白线条涂鸦图集，绘有数十个身披兜帽长袍、手持法杖、刀剑、弓弩、骷髅与坩埚的狂信者。

name: grinning pale wraith
desc: A grainy black-and-white circular token of a pale ghostly face with hollow black eyes and a wide bared-teeth grin.
desc_zh: 黑白颗粒质感的圆形代币，描绘一张苍白的鬼脸，眼窝空洞漆黑，咧嘴露齿狞笑。

name: spiky maw aberration
desc: A circular horror token showing a black spiky silhouette with a curved row of glinting teeth at its center.
desc_zh: 圆形恐怖代币，中央是一个黑色多刺剪影，带有一排弯月状闪亮的利齿。

name: horned beast head
desc: A grainy black-and-white circular token of a horned beast head with glowing white eyes and nostrils.
desc_zh: 黑白颗粒质感的圆形代币，描绘一个双眼与鼻孔发光的有角兽头。

name: pointed-hood penitent
desc: A grainy circular token of a hooded figure wearing a tall pointed cap with faint glowing eyes in shadow.
desc_zh: 颗粒质感的圆形代币，描绘一个戴高耸尖顶兜帽的人影，阴影中双眼微光闪烁。

name: skull-faced revenant
desc: A grainy circular token of a dark skull with hollow sockets and bared teeth rising from shadowed shoulders.
desc_zh: 颗粒质感的圆形代币，描绘一个眼窝空洞、龇着牙齿的暗黑骷髅头，下方是阴影般的肩颈。

name: hooded toothy shadow
desc: A grainy circular token of a hooded black shape whose dark maw reveals a single row of glinting white teeth.
desc_zh: 颗粒质感的圆形代币，描绘一个兜帽黑影，黑暗的口中露出一排闪亮的白牙。

name: screaming creep
desc: A dark beast-like creature throws its head back and screams, spraying grit from its wide, tooth-filled maw.
desc_zh: 一只漆黑的兽形生物仰头嘶吼，布满尖牙的大口中喷溅出碎屑。

name: snarling hound
desc: A ferocious dark hound snarls with a glowing eye, bared fangs, and strings of saliva hanging from its jaws.
desc_zh: 一只漆黑的恶犬龇着獠牙咆哮，眼睛发光，嘴角垂下缕缕涎丝。

name: howling beast
desc: A dark creature with a pointed snout rears its head upward, its toothy maw open and a single eye glowing.
desc_zh: 一只尖吻的黑暗生物仰起头颅，利齿大口张开，独眼发出亮光。

name: nightmare steed
desc: A spectral black horse with a bristling mane turns its head, one eye glowing pale white.
desc_zh: 一匹鬃毛竖立的漆黑魔马转过头来，一只眼睛泛着惨白的光。

name: radiant-faced wraith
desc: A cloaked figure in a broad-brimmed hat bears a blazing white void for a face, radiating light over armored shoulders.
desc_zh: 一个戴宽檐帽的披风身影顶着炽白如虚空的面孔，光芒笼罩在甲肩之上。

name: Bat-eared mutant creature
desc: A grainy high-contrast black-and-white circular token showing a bald mutant creature with huge fringed bat-like ears, hollow eyes, an open mouth, and stitched flesh across its shoulder.
desc_zh: 一枚颗粒感强烈的高对比黑白圆形代币，画面是一个秃头、长着巨大蝠状褶耳、眼窝深陷、张口露齿且肩部带有缝线的突变生物。

name: hooded lurker
desc: A hooded figure in a dark feathered cloak lurks in profile, a single glinting eye visible in the shadow.
desc_zh: 一个身披黑色羽状斗篷的兜帽身影侧身潜立，阴影中只露出一只闪亮的眼睛。

name: grinning monster
desc: A round-headed monster grins with rows of sharp teeth, one small eye glowing above a pale collar at its neck.
desc_zh: 一个圆头怪物咧着一排排尖牙狞笑，颈间浅色领圈上方一只小眼发光。

name: haggard wraith
desc: A gaunt wraith with wild black hair and hollow features stares forward, one eye glowing pale white.
desc_zh: 一个面容枯槁、黑发散乱的怨灵直视前方，一只眼睛泛着惨白的光。

name: horned knight
desc: A heavily armored warrior in a horned helmet with spiked pauldrons, rendered in gritty high-contrast black and white inside a circular token ring.
desc_zh: 圆形代币内以高对比黑白颗粒风格描绘的一名头戴双角盔、肩披尖刺甲的重甲战士。

name: toothy hooded ghoul
desc: A hooded creature with a pale crown and a grin of sharp teeth looms out of grainy monochrome shadow within a circular token.
desc_zh: 圆形代币中一个头戴兜帽、头顶苍白、露出一排尖牙的怪物从黑白颗粒阴影中逼近。

name: glowing-eyed mutant face
desc: A tilted bald head with luminous hollow eyes and a ribbed collar stares out from grainy black-and-white texture in a circular token.
desc_zh: 圆形代币中一颗倾斜的光头面孔，空洞的双眼发着光，领口呈罗纹状，画面为黑白颗粒质感。

name: white-eyed wraith woman
desc: A long-haired figure with glowing white slit eyes emerges from deep shadow in grainy monochrome inside a circular token.
desc_zh: 圆形代币内一个长发身影从浓重阴影中浮现，双眼发出白色亮光，画面为颗粒感黑白风格。

name: hooded lurker
desc: A cloaked figure in a deep hood with two faint glinting eyes is drawn in gritty high-contrast black and white within a circular token.
desc_zh: 圆形代币中一个深陷兜帽、披着斗篷的身影，双眼微光闪烁，以高对比黑白颗粒风格绘制。

name: victorian lady in profile
desc: A woman shown in profile with her hair in a bun and a drop earring, wearing a dark high-collared dress, in grainy monochrome inside a circular token.
desc_zh: 圆形代币内一位侧面示人的女子，挽着发髻、戴坠饰耳环，身着深色高领衣裙，画面为黑白颗粒质感。

name: kettle-helm soldier
desc: A warrior in a pointed kettle helmet that shadows the eyes, wearing scale armor over long hair, rendered in grainy black and white within a circular token.
desc_zh: 圆形代币中一名战士头戴尖顶笠盔遮住双眼、长发披肩并身着鳞甲，以黑白颗粒风格呈现。

name: fur-hat courtier with ruff
desc: A pale face with dark lips peeks from beneath a towering dark fur hat, framed by a frilled ruff collar, in grainy monochrome inside a circular token.
desc_zh: 圆形代币内一张苍白面孔露出深色嘴唇，上方被高耸的深色毛帽遮眼，颈间围着褶边皱领，画面为黑白颗粒质感。

name: Fanged Underthing
desc: A hunched, bat-eared creature with a gaping maw of needle teeth leers from a grim circular token.
desc_zh: 一个佝偻、长着蝙蝠耳、豁开满口针状獠牙的生物，在阴森的圆形 token 上狞笑。

name: Beggar King of the Gutters
desc: A ragged, hollow-cheeked man with a crooked crown of scrap peers out with cunning eyes in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个衣衫褴褛、双颊凹陷、头戴废料弯冠的男人，目光狡黠，潦草墨线风格。

name: Iron-Hooded Watchman
desc: A stern watchman's face behind a riveted iron helm's visor slits, drawn in heavy scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一张严峻的守望者面孔出现在铆钉铁盔的面甲缝隙后，以粗重的潦草墨线绘成。

name: One-Eyed Smuggler
desc: A weathered smuggler with an eyepatch, stubble, and a sly half-grin smokes a crooked pipe in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个饱经风霜、戴眼罩、面带狡黠假笑的走私者叼着弯烟斗，潦草墨线风格。

name: Doomed Noble
desc: A gaunt aristocrat with slicked hair and a tall collar gazes with hollow, resigned eyes in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一位梳着油头、竖着高领的憔悴贵族，眼神空洞而听天由命，潦草墨线风格。

name: Bell-Ringing Flagellant
desc: A hooded penitent with a wild beard rings a hand bell, face twisted in ecstatic fervor, in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个戴着兜帽、胡须狂乱忏悔者摇着手铃，脸因狂热而扭曲，潦草墨线风格。

name: Gap-Toothed Gravedigger
desc: A grim laborer with a heavy brow, toothy gap, and dirt-smudged face grins over a shovel in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个眉头粗重、豁着牙、脸上沾着泥污的阴沉劳工对着铁铲咧嘴而笑，潦草墨线风格。

name: Plague Doctor
desc: A beaked plague-doctor mask with round glass eyes looms from the dark circle, drawn in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一张长着鸟喙、镶着圆玻璃眼的瘟疫医生面具从黑暗的圆环中浮现，潦草墨线风格。

name: Wizened Herbalist
desc: A wrinkled old herbalist in a headscarf with sharp eyes clutches a sprig of leaves in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一位裹着头巾、目光锐利、满脸皱纹的老草药师紧攥着一小枝叶子，潦草墨线风格。

name: Hook-Nosed Bird-Masked Figure
desc: A sinister figure in a wide-brimmed hat with a long beaked bird mask stares forward in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个戴宽檐帽、套着长喙鸟面具的阴森身影直视前方，潦草墨线风格。

name: Grinning Shade
desc: A bald, shadowy humanoid with glowing pale eyes and a jagged grin emerging from darkness.
desc_zh: 一个秃顶的阴影般人形生物，苍白的眼睛发着光，咧开参差不齐的嘴从黑暗中浮现。

name: Squinting Cutpurse
desc: A sly young cutpurse with a skewed cap and narrow squint smirks in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个歪戴着帽子、眯着眼的狡黠年轻扒手得意地笑着，潦草墨线风格。

name: Tonsured Scribe
desc: A bald-pated scribe with heavy rings under his eyes looks up from his ledger with a weary frown in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一位头顶剃光、眼下发青的抄经士从账册上抬起头，疲惫地皱着眉，潦草墨线风格。

name: Lantern-Jawed Man-at-Arms
desc: A hard-bitten soldier with a square jaw and stubble wears a mail coif, drawn in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一位下巴方正、胡茬粗硬的佣兵戴着锁子头巾，潦草墨线风格。

name: Grinning Tinker
desc: A cheerful, weathered tinker in a floppy hat grins gap-toothed amid curls of pipe smoke in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一位戴软帽、饱经风霜、心情大好的补锅匠叼着烟斗咧嘴而笑，露出了豁牙，潦草墨线风格。

name: Worm-Eaten Husk
desc: A hollow-eyed, skin-stretched skull face riddled with worms grins from the grim circle in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一张眼窝空洞、皮肤紧绷、布满蛆虫的头骨脸从阴森的圆环中咧嘴而笑，潦草墨线风格。

name: Half-Flayed Penitent
desc: A tormented face with flayed, sinewy skin stretched over the skull screams in silent agony in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一张受尽折磨的脸，剥了皮的肌肉紧贴头骨，无声地嘶吼着，潦草墨线风格。

name: Cultist in Ritual Mask
desc: A hooded cultist wearing a smooth, featureless ritual mask looms out of the dark circle in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个戴兜帽、套着光滑无面目仪式面具的信徒从黑暗圆环中隐现，潦草墨线风格。

name: Lantern Bearer
desc: A wide-eyed wanderer in a pointed hood raises a small lantern toward the viewer in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个戴着尖顶兜帽、瞪大眼睛的流浪者朝观者举起一盏小提灯，潦草墨线风格。

name: Gutter Snipe
desc: A sharp-featured street urchin with a mischievous smirk and unruly hair peeks out in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个五官尖刻、头发蓬乱、坏笑着的街头顽童探出头来，潦草墨线风格。

name: Hollow-Eyed Wraith
desc: A gaunt hooded figure with glowing white eyes stares from a grainy black void.
desc_zh: 一个瘦削的兜帽身影，发光的白眼从斑驳的黑暗中凝视。

name: Veiled Cultist of Ash
desc: A pale masked figure in a dark hood with bone-white adornments stares hollowly from a grim hand-drawn token.
desc_zh: 一个戴着苍白面具、头戴饰有白色骨饰兜帽的身影，以黑暗手绘风格空洞地凝视着。

name: Ratcatcher of the Undercity
desc: A wiry man in a leather cap with a scraggly beard holds a small rodent, rendered in scratchy ink lines.
desc_zh: 一个戴着皮帽、胡子凌乱的精瘦男子手里抓着一只小老鼠，以潦草的墨线手绘风格呈现。

name: Poxmarked Merchant
desc: A gaunt merchant with pockmarked skin, a tricorn hat, and a furtive leer poses in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个脸颊布满痘疤、戴着三角帽、面露鬼祟讪笑的憔悴商人，墨线手绘风格。

name: Hooded Malcontent
desc: A sallow, unshaven face beneath a deep hood glares sideways with suspicion in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 兜帽下一张蜡黄、胡茬杂乱的脸，带着怀疑斜眼怒视，潦草墨线风格。

name: Scarred Pit Fighter
desc: A battered warrior with a broken nose, facial scars, and a wary scowl peers from a dark circular token.
desc_zh: 一个鼻梁塌陷、面部带疤、神情警惕的饱经战斗的战士，从暗色圆形 token 中凝视。

name: Pale Cult Zealot
desc: A wide-eyed zealot with sunken cheeks and a shaved scalp daubed with ritual markings gazes upward in scratchy ink.
desc_zh: 一个眼窝深陷、头皮剃光并涂有仪式印记的狂热信徒睁大眼睛向上凝视，潦草墨线风格。
